lessons.title: Week 8 Part 1: Understanding Coercive Control, Fear & Child Impact
lessons.content: In Week 8 of Domestic & Family Violence Safety & Accountability, this lesson focuses on understanding coercive control, fear & child impact. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
